summary.en:
- Bronya is a hypercarry support capable of buffing a single target with her Skill.
- Bronya is able to fully action advance a single ally with her Skill. Her Ultimate provides a full teamwide ATK boost.
- While Bronya falls behind specialized support options, her buffs and action advance make her a solid second choice in many teams.

details.en:
- E2 increases the Skill's target SPD by 30%.
- E6 extends the duration of the Skill's DMG Boost by 1 turn.
